sanskrit: iti eṣa pūroḥ vaṃśaḥ tu pāṇḍavānām ca kīrtitaḥ
english: "Thus have I, O king, recited the history of the descendants of Puru and of the Pandavas.

Ownership If someone finds lost property whose owner is unknown, he should disclose it to the king. The king should have it publicized and keep it safely for a year, after which time a quarter goes to the finder and the rest to the king.
This is how Bhairava is contemplated on as the resort of the will of creativity, power of division, knowledge and power as well as thorn in the lotus and thus the inner nature of all the beings.

english: There are some people, according to whom the word-sound is apprehended by the auditory organ, when it is produced but not in actual contact with that organ;—for them, the absence of contact being equally present in the case of distant and near sounds, the apprehension and non-apprehension by people far and near would be equally possible; and there could be no order of sequence, nor the greater and less intensity (of sounds heard).”—[Ślokavārtika—eternality of words, 119-121]
